hooks.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cwd'); name=$(basename "$cwd"); if echo "$name" | grep -q '^dangeresque-'; then fp=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); case "$fp" in "$cwd"/*|"") exit 0;; *) tool=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name'); echo "dangeresque: refusing $tool on $fp — outside worktree $cwd. Use a worktree-relative absolute path. (Simple prefix check: ../ traversal and symlinks NOT covered — threat model is misrouted-but-well-meaning workers.)" >&2; exit 2;; esac; fi
cwd=$(cat | jq -r '.cwd'); name=$(basename "$cwd"); if echo "$name" | grep -q '^dangeresque-'; then osascript -e "display notification \"$name needs attention\" with title \"dangeresque\""; fi
cwd=$(cat | jq -r '.cwd'); name=$(basename "$cwd"); if echo "$name" | grep -q '^dangeresque-'; then osascript -e "display notification \"$name complete\" with title \"dangeresque\""; fi
